status: Retrospective same-study split, specified before fitting digitized values. Article figures and reported fits have already been read; not blind validation.
dataset: Figure 6 M1 black diamonds only; M2 and M3 are not pooled or fitted
selection_reason: Authors identify M1 as the more stable series in Sections 3.3/4.1. Its entire visible series is digitized, with no residual-based exclusions.
calibration_selection: Odd one-based ranks after ordering by increasing support flux
holdout_selection: Even one-based ranks after ordering by increasing support flux
model: 1/P_total = 1/P_support + Z_fixed, with permeance P in m/(Pa s) and impedance Z in Pa s/m
objective: Equal-weight least squares of measured Z_fixed = 1/P_total - 1/P_support. Only the positive intercept is fitted; the support coefficient is fixed at 1.

primary_screen.basis: Project engineering screen set before fitting, not a measurement uncertainty or statistical acceptance test.

digitization.interpretation: Deterministic reading/axis sensitivity bounds, not experimental error bars or confidence intervals.
digitization.method: Threshold dark components in a recorded Figure 6 region; inspect numbered overlay against all black-diamond data markers. Preserve raw pixel centres and image hash.

use_impedance_instead_of_intrinsic_perme: Avoid assigning an unreported water viscosity or specimen-specific support thickness. Z_fixed is effective non-support impedance, including any interface/access contribution; not a separately measured intrinsic selective-layer property.

conditional_process.scope: Measured 1-bar conductances translated to fixed 100 LMH under linear Darcy flow, same water conditions and unchanged fixed layer. No circulation, fouling, osmotic, backwash or strength-certified energy prediction.

scientific_scope: Test the measured support/whole-membrane series law, not a reconstructed OpenLB geometry. Digitized points share one experiment and unknown replicate/error structure. Preserve the earlier Biesheuvel failed screen.
